answer: SIM-shell identity: $37 per fake to start. Each agent is a walnut — one carrier-attested SIM per key, $25 activation plus $12 a month. Every epoch the carrier texts a fresh code to the number and the agent must answer it within 10 minutes from the handset holding that SIM; peers see the carrier's signed delivery receipt, a plume of live replies no script can forge. A dead, ported, or bulk-registered line fails the jade seal and the identity freezes. A farm needs 1,000 live SIMs in 1,000 handsets answering at once, so the cost lands per fake, not per farm.
